name: OpenCode Go Teams

price.note: $20 per member per month. Minimum 2 members ($40 a month) since 12 Nov 2026.

reset.rule: Opens at your first request and lasts 5 hours. You can spend up to 20% of the month in one window.
stipulations: Before a window starts, the API reports a reset 5 hours from now.

reset.rule: Resets Monday 00:00 UTC. You can spend up to 50% of the month in one week.

meters.label: Monthly allowance
meters.hint: Per member. Each model cap is $5 above Go

reset.rule: Resets when a new paid period starts.
stipulations: Each model has its own monthly $ cap. Usage counts as a share of that cap, so $1.50 on a $15-cap model uses 10%.
Token prices are the same on Go, Go Plus and Go Teams. Only the caps differ.
A refund is possible within 14 days if you have used almost none of the period.

overage: Extra Usage is on by default and bills the workspace credit balance at pay-as-you-go prices once a member hits a limit. Turn it off on the Go page. Free models keep working, with a daily request cap.

how: Each member has their own 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowances. There is no team pool.
Each per-model monthly cap is $5 higher than on Go.
No more than 20% of the month per 5 hours and 50% per week, per member.
ext: Models from other labs: Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 4 Argon, plus Kimi, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax and more. The model list is the same on every Go tier.
Works in Claude Code, Codex, Hermes (v0.21.6 or later), ZCode, Pi, jcode (v0.81.6 or later) and Kilo Code CLI through the Go API. OpenCode says it may not keep supporting them.
Known problems with GitHub Copilot Chat, Kimi Code, MiMo Code and DeepSeek Harness. Clients must send a stable x-opencode-session header.
quirks: DeepSeek and LongCat models only work after you enable the Global region in Settings → Privacy.
Muse Spark only works after you allow endpoints that train on your data. Those endpoints are blocked by default.
The documented usage API is GET /inference/go/v1/usage. The live model list is at /inference/go/v1/models.
A member who joins mid-month is charged the full $20 with no proration and gets a full monthly allowance. Removing a member lowers the next renewal.
Decision and embedding models bill at list price with no Go discount, up to $15 per member a month.
Owners and admins set model regions and data-training policy for the whole workspace.
Upgrading from Go or Go Plus starts Teams at once and credits the unused allowance.
The launch changelog says owners can cap each member's spend in Controls. The docs don't mention it yet.

events.what: The DeepSeek zero-data-retention agreement runs to this date. OpenCode says it renews monthly.
